content_sections.heading: TMC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. TMC/HBCHRCV/AD/68/26 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download TMC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Sc in Genetics OR Graduate degree in relevant subject with 03-year post qualification relevant experience Experience: 03-year post qualification relevant experience mandatory Other conditions: Candidate is ready to provide any additional employment proof documents if required pre or post interview.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Tenure of services will be for a fixed period of six months from the date of joining and further extendable as per requirement. The above-mentioned posts are purely temporary.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Updated resume Recent passport size photograph Pan Card Aadhar card Original certificates One set of self-attested copies of all certificates (Education, Experience/Relieving & last 3 months Payslip)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Interested candidates may come along with updated resume, recent passport size photograph, photo copy of Pan Card, Aadhar card. Bring original certificates and one set of self-attested copies of all certificates at HRD Department first floor Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital Research Centre, Visakhapatnam. Attend on 7 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: It is mandatory to bring all original certificates and one set of Xerox copies at the time of interview, without which candidate strictly will not be allowed to attend the interview.
